subject: SIG questionnaire initiation Acme Health
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation Acme Health

Hi Liam 

Thanks again for the call this morning  great to learn more about Acme Health's use case and risk objectives. Per our discussion, I'm kicking off the vendor security questionnaire so your team can validate controls. Two quick notes up front: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2026 (happy to attach the report) and we support HIPAA-compliant deployments (we offer Private / VPC options + BAA).

Attached: a copy of our SOC 2 summary for reference and a blank SIG template we usually work from. Could you confirm which format you prefer (SIG Excel vs your portal)? Also a few clarifying Qs so we prioritize the right evidence:
- Scope: will you need ePHI covered for initial review, or is this a non-ePHI evaluation?
- Timeline: what's your ideal turnaround for a completed questionnaire?
- Evidence: are there specific sections/modules you want completed first (e.g., IAM, encryption, incident mgmt)?
- Subprocessors: do you want our full subprocessor list now or after we scope the modules?

Proposed next step: a 30-min working session next week to walk the SIG with your security analyst and assign owners. I'm copying Marissa from our security & CSM team  she'll join the call and help track evidence.

Thanks  looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (SOC 2 summary, redacted) ; SIG_Questionnaire_Acme_Health.xlsx (blank SIG template)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation Acme Health

Camila 

Thanks for the quick follow-up and for sending the SOC summary. We prefer the SIG Excel for tracking, so that's perfect. I've attached our internal SIG request (same workbook with a few prefills). A couple of clarifying points from our side:
- We will need coverage for ePHI  Acme is scoping this as part of a pilot that will process PHI. Please confirm you can sign a BAA.
- Timeline: target is 10 business days for initial responses, but we can adjust based on evidence needed.
- Encryption: please confirm encryption at rest and in transit, and whether you offer customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

I'll loop in security@acmehealth.com and procurement so they see the thread. Can we plan the working session for next Wednesday at 12:00 ET? If that works, send a calendar invite.

Thanks  attaching: Acme_SIG_Request_filled.xlsx (our prefills).

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; security@acmehealth.com; procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation Acme Health

Hi Liam / team 

Appreciate the prefills  that helps. Quick answers and next steps:

1) BAA / ePHI: Redwood will sign a BAA for customers processing ePHI. We support HIPAA-compliant deployments via our Private offering (VPC + customer controls). I'll attach a redacted SOC 2 report now for your review. For the BAA, we typically route via DocuSign once scope is confirmed; happy to start that in parallel.

2) Encryption / KMS: We encrypt in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. We support customer-managed key options (bring-your-own-key) for Dedicated/Private deployments via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault)  we can provide a short tech note for your infra team.

3) Evidence & scope: To keep within your 10-business-day target, suggest we prioritize IAM, encryption, logging/monitoring, and incident response. If you can flag any 'deal breakers' we can escalate.

4) Subprocessors: we can share our current subprocessor list (production) under NDA; would you like that now?

5) Working session: next Wed 12:00 ET works for me and I'll send a calendar invite. Marissa will join to handle evidence collection and track owners.

A couple clarifying Qs from our side to speed the response:
- For items that require screenshots/config (e.g., encryption config, network diagrams), do you prefer screenshots embedded in the SIG workbook or links to a shared Drive folder?
- Is there a separate procurement intake (PO/contract team) we should include when we send the BAA?

Thanks  attaching: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (redacted).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation Acme Health

Camila 

Received the SOC doc, thanks  looks good at first glance. Couple follow-ups:
- Drive links are fine for larger config evidence; screenshots in the workbook work for quick items. We'll create a shared folder and send access.
- Procurement: include procurement@acmehealth.com on any BAA/contract threads; they handle PO/terms.
- Subprocessors: please share the current list under NDA; procurement/security will mark anything that needs additional review.
- KMS: confirming you support customer-managed keys is helpful  our infra team will follow up with a short list of integration questions (HSM vs KMS, rotation, key access audit).

Working session confirmed: Wed 26 May 2027 at 12:00 ET. I'll send a calendar invite with our security analyst (Anita Shah) and procurement.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Liam
